description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 005 are a clay screen design shown in the product photo around an outdoor kitchen and bar in a garden, a practical pick for anyone choosing terracotta jali for outdoor kitchen walls where smoke and heat need somewhere to go.

## How it looks
In the photo the jali wraps the back and sides of a garden cooking and bar area, giving it a defined edge while the openings keep it from feeling boxed in. The earthy terracotta colour tends to sit well with brick counters, stone tops and plants, and it does not show soot as starkly as a white wall would.

## Where it works
- **Jali screen for BBQ area** behind a grill or tandoor corner, letting smoke drift out.
- **Garden bar jali wall** to frame a seating counter on a lawn or rooftop.
- **Outdoor kitchen screen design** that hides gas cylinders, storage or a service door.

Clay is fired at high heat and tends to cope well with sun and weather outdoors. Even so, keep the screen a safe distance from open flame and follow your installer's advice on clearances.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Use shown: outdoor kitchen and bar screen in a garden
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you design the counter and wall.

Grease and smoke can mark porous clay, so a breathable clay sealer is worth considering near cooking. Clean with warm water and a mild, non-acid soap and a soft brush.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) and share a sketch or photo of your space for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of terracotta jali for an outdoor kitchen?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Is terracotta jali safe near a BBQ or tandoor?
faqs.a: Fired clay tends to tolerate heat better than wood or plastic screens, but it should not sit directly against open flame. Leave a clearance and follow your installer's advice.

faqs.q: Terracotta jali or cement jali for an outdoor kitchen?
faqs.a: Both work outdoors. Terracotta gives a warm natural colour and hides soot better than light grey; cement jali can be painted. A sealer helps either one resist grease.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 005" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
